channel.title: Ctrl+Enter
channel.description: A personal podcast to learn, on the bike, how to make acid techno live with Strudel: music basics, sounds, arrangement, build and drop. Voices by ElevenLabs, examples rendered in strudel.cc.
channel.itunes:subtitle: Learning acid techno by live coding with Strudel
channel.itunes:author: Ctrl+Enter

item.title: Ep. 0 — The Map
item.description: We build one whole acid track, from a blank screen to the drop, in ten minutes: tempo and cycles, kick and grid, accents, the TB-303 (cutoff, resonance), the five moves of arrangement, break, build, drop. Code in the show notes.
